description: Evaluate supplied product facts through the same deterministic USPS, UPS and FedEx rule runtime used by the CanWeShip checker. Use the fact ids from get_product_guidance questions. Unknown or invalid facts are ignored and never treated as clearance; next_questions lists the facts still open, in the order the checker asks them.

carriers.description: Optional carrier subset; defaults to all three carriers.

facts.description: Facts already confirmed by the user, keyed by question id, for example { "device_condition": "used", "battery_wh": 52.6 }.

slug.description: A product slug from list_products (laptop, power-bank), a named product (iphone-15, anker-737-power-bank, aerosol-deodorant) or a product name or alias (cbd oil).

name: check_product
title: Evaluate Product Shipping Facts
